description.value: A downtown Vancouver restaurant blending Mediterranean and Persian cuisine, serving donairs, kebabs, wraps, and traditional Persian stews such as Ghormeh Sabzi and Khoresh Fesenjan. Located on Seymour Street in the heart of the city, it offers both indoor dine-in and convenient pickup or delivery via Uber Eats and DoorDash. The hearty, flavour-forward menu makes it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists moving through the downtown core.
